column1: # Shared vectors for the T3 Code v0.1.7 placement scorer.
# tests/fm-place.test.sh runs every case through the pinned upstream selector
# (bin/vendor/t3code/load-balancing.ts, under Bun) and through the Firstmate
# must give the expected winner and rejection set. Upstream returns only a
# winner, so a candidate is in its rejection set when choosing among that
# `unobserved` is a fact the probe could not read: an unobserved cpu_util is
# upstream's null, and any other unobserved fact is a missing snapshot.
